]> 14/08/2026 10:36 More Sunshine and Blue Skies!.

We're in for a stunning bluebird day at Perisher! The forecast is calling for partly cloudy, but there's barely a cloud in sight this morning, just clear skies and sunshine to kick off your day. There's some light wind about, topping out around 26km/h, and while the current temp is sitting around 1 degrees, we're headed for a warm top of 7 degrees.

With conditions settling nicely after the storm, we've got 40 lifts expected to spin and 58 groomed runs across the resort, so there's plenty of room to spread out and enjoy the sunshine.

Around the resort today, we have the Red Bull Boom Box at Front Valley Slopestyle Park playing some tunes as well as live music with Vibe Band at the Jax Bar from 2:30pm, be sure to check it all out!

Looking ahead, we've got a big weekend of live music and events coming up! the Subaru Scavenger Hunt kicks off tomorrow, followed by Val's Blue Steel Rail Rumble presented by Oakley this Sunday which is an event you won't want to miss. With this great weather set to stick around, it's shaping up to be a cracking weekend!
